text:
Emily Support: FYI customer NimbusHealth (acct nimbus-77) flagged a weird credit situation after a mid-cycle downgrade. Invoice INV-2026-334 shows CN-2026-887 but there's a $0.01 remaining balance and customer is asking for a refund :confused:
Sanjay Finance: Seen this before — usually a rounding + tax conversion mismatch when PO is EUR but invoice was generated in USD. PO#: PO-99823, tax-exempt true for the customer, but tax line was zeroed differently during proration. CN created for $1,234.56 but invoice balance shows -$1,234.55 (so $0.01 gap).
Jordan BillingEng: Can you attach the invoice/credit payload? I suspect our proration algo does banker's rounding in a different step than the tax calc. Also noticed an internal error when trying to auto-apply the CN: request returned 500 for invoice in state "partially_paid".
Emily Support: repro files: INV-2026-334, CN-2026-887, PO-99823 — customer says they only want the leftover refunded to the card after PO consumption. They also tried to apply the credit via API and saw a 500.
Jordan BillingEng: quick repro steps I used locally:
```
POST /internal/invoices/INV-2026-334/apply_credit
{
  "credit_note_id": "CN-2026-887",
  "apply_amount": 1234.56,
  "currency": "USD"
}
// response 500
{
  "error": "internal_error",
  "message": "integer overflow in cents rounding"
}
```
Sanjay Finance: looks like the apply_amount rounding to cents was done before currency conversion back to EUR for PO reconciliation — leads to a 1-cent drift. Also tax_exempt flag was applied after prorate, producing a different taxable base.
Luis AM: Customer wants a one-off manual refund. Do we have a clear manual process? They have an active PO and procurement requires a note on the credit application.
Nina CS: I told them we'll do a manual refund and follow up with patch timeline. Need the support ticket ID to put in the memo. Ticket: SUP-7812.
Sanjay Finance: Manual ops we should do: 1) Create an adjustment credit CN-MANUAL-2026-01 for $0.01 to zero out the balance, 2) Record a journal entry offsetting CN-2026-887 to show PO consumption, 3) Initiate a refund for any card charge difference if card was used. I can do the journal and create the tiny credit once we confirm approval.
Jordan BillingEng: I'll triage the 500. Root cause: rounding order + tax-exempt flag applied post-prorate. Proposed fix: canonicalize to cents at the end of proration + ensure tax-exempt adjusts taxable base before rounding. I'll open an internal PR and coordinate a hotfix for the apply_credit endpoint.
billing-bot: deploy scheduled to staging for billing-hotfix at 2026-04-18T22:30:00Z (pipeline #3421) :rocket:
Emily Support: action items for this thread: @Sanjay Finance will do manual CN adjustment + journal and add note referencing SUP-7812, @Jordan BillingEng to open PR and run hotfix pipeline, @Nina CS to confirm refund instruction with customer. I'll update the ticket once manual credit created.
Luis AM: please cc procurement contact: marie.procurement@nimbushealth.com in the memo when you do journal/credit note.
Sanjay Finance: noted — will add PO-99823 and SUP-7812 to memo. Targeting manual fix today and hotfix early tomorrow.
Emily Support: thanks — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
